purpose: Stage 2 Prereq D: SHAP attribution + ML indicator fingerprint per recipe (Component 8 prong 3 of docs/specs/internal/ops/ml-track/07-validation-framework.md). Diagnostic for country-fixed-effect contamination per Tariq Sufi-Younes' binding warning. Stage 2 walk reads this to investigate top-K features ranked top by SHAP that have low within-country temporal variance (= fixed-effect proxies).

method.variance_reference: for each engineered feature, per-country std over training window, then median across countries. Computed on the SAME feature space the model sees (post-first-difference) so indicator IDs match the SHAP top-K labels.

policy.no_bh_fdr_note: QGI hard-veto per Kwame Adjei; raw mean_abs_shap values only; downstream consumers must not apply correction.
